title.zh: 查询指定标签键对应的标签值

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，为您查询杭州地域资源栈已绑定标签的标签键`TagKey1`对应的标签值。
descriptions.en: In this example, the tag values of `TagKey1` that is added to a stack in the China (Hangzhou) region are queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros list-tag-values --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type stack --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --key TagKey1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros ListTagValues --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --ResourceType stack --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Key TagKey1
